resources.string: Multilingual embedding model for the knowledge base and document search. About 334 MB, Gemma license. Best default for English and Spanish. Switching embedding models later requires re-indexing your documents.

Strong multilingual embedding model (100+ languages), 1024-dimension vectors. About 639 MB, Apache-2.0. Slower than EmbeddingGemma on phones. Switching embedding models later requires re-indexing your documents.
Small, fast English-focused embedding model. About 84 MB, Apache-2.0. Weaker on Spanish and other languages. Switching embedding models later requires re-indexing your documents.
